extras.title: Play on PC: MAME forked from 0.289 with Mortal Kombat 4 lighting
extras.description: A Windows 64-bit MAME forked from MAME 0.289 (master cfc4760a, 2026-10-03) with experimental per-vertex lighting for the Midway Zeus 1 video driver and a crash fix for quads clipped to three vertices. It is not made or supported by the MAME team; please do not report problems with it to MAMEdev. No ROMs are included.
extras.install: Unzip archive, put mk4.zip and tms320c32.zip in the roms folder, then double-click Play MK4 (lighting).bat.
extras.media_note: Captured from the MK4 MiSTer FPGA core v16 with its Lighting Toggle. The MAME fork uses the same light and normal data without the core's MK4-specific tuning, so it does not look identical.
